headline: TRITN surged 50.00% on light volume while XBIO jumped 14.29% after a high‑priority clarification filing.
market_take: Across the 232‑ticker universe, construction and food stocks dominated today’s activity with several large price swings and volume spikes. Unusual‑trading alerts were concentrated in CONS (TRITN, APCS, SRICHA) and FOOD (XBIO, ZEN, SAPPE). Notable filings included XBIO’s clarification request and multiple asset‑sale or capital‑change disclosures in PROP and PF&REIT.

sector_notes.note: XBIO opened with a 14.29% gap and filed a high‑priority clarification; ZEN recorded a 57.2σ volume spike and SAPPE a 3.8σ spike. F&D fell 11.00% on negligible volume, while AQUA slipped 9.09% intraday.
TRITN surged 50.00% intraday; APCS showed a 27.59% open gap but a -23.24% intraday move; SRICHA rose 10.06% with a 3.0σ volume spike; SOLAR dropped 7.69% intraday; RT gained 6.90%.
EVER declined 16.67% and CGD fell 9.09% (volume ×7.1); JCK posted a -7.14% open gap; CMC rose 5.71% on strong volume (×8.72). Asset‑sale filings were reported for ORI and STELLA.
SSPF fell 7.74% intraday; KPNREIT disclosed a capital change and loan agreement; CPTREIT announced a capital reduction.
